findings.evidence: Windows drive paths, traversal, symlinks and private addresses are separate bypass classes.
findings.fix: Normalize before and after resolution; reject drive/absolute/traversal/symlink/hardlink cases and private/metadata address classes.

corrections: Security tests cover injection, timeout, cancellation, protected paths and transactional patch mismatch.
receipts.revisit: Filesystem, archive or network functionality changes

findings.evidence: Timeout and cancellation must terminate descendants, not only the parent.
findings.risk: Escaped background processes could outlive a task.
findings.fix: Start a process group/session and terminate the group on timeout or cancellation.

corrections: Tracked communicate and cancellation tasks and bounded output.

findings.evidence: An image build alone did not exercise sandbox restrictions.
findings.risk: Non-root or capability settings could silently regress.
findings.fix: CI loads the built image and runs a non-root, read-only, network-none, capability-dropped security contract.

evidence_commands: GitHub Actions docker job: Run Docker sandbox security contract
receipts.revisit: Dockerfile, image, or sandbox flags change

findings.evidence: Legacy Sandbox protocol is an interface, not a second implementation.
findings.risk: Duplicate runners would split policy enforcement.
findings.fix: Command execution is canonical in CommandRunner and tool execution in ToolRegistry.

corrections: Removed dynamic module import from process creation.

findings.evidence: Security cases assert caller-visible denial and filesystem state.
findings.risk: Internal-call assertions would not prove confinement.
findings.fix: Tests verify unchanged content, exact argument behavior, bounded output and typed denial.

findings.evidence: Live Fly behavior has no credentialed evidence.
findings.fix: Explicitly labels Fly as a typed boundary with owner-triggered live tests.

corrections: Docker claims tied to CI command.
evidence_commands: rg -n 'docker run|class FlySandboxAdapter|class ToolRegistry' .github src docs
